info.title: Tiducto Transit API — Places
info.description: Place search over the environment's service area (stops, addresses, streets, municipalities and points of interest), key-authenticated. Companion to routing, stops and realtime; the four share one pack version. A member that has no value is absent, never null. `type` is an open set: new values may be added, and a client ignores a type it does not know. A stop's `id` is the value routing's `stopLocation.stopLocationId` takes. Addresses, streets and municipalities are from RÚIAN, the Czech register of addresses and territorial units (© ČÚZK, CC BY 4.0); points of interest are from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL); results carry those attribution obligations. A query parameter not listed is a 400 `<name> is not allowed`, and a repeated one a 400 `<name> is invalid`. A method an operation doesn't take is a 405 `method_not_allowed`. A path that matches no operation, and every path of an environment without places search, is the gateway's plain-text `404 Not Found`, outside every operation.

servers.description: Your environment. Replace `{env-slug}` with your environment's slug.

get.description:
Place search over the environment's service area: stops, addresses, streets, municipalities and their parts, city districts and points of interest.
- `q` and `limit` are required; absent is a 400 `<name> is required`, and `q` empty after trimming whitespace is `q is required`.
- `q` is 2 to 100 characters after trimming whitespace; shorter or longer is a 400 `q is out of range`.
- `limit` is an integer from 1 to 20; not an integer is a 400 `limit is invalid`, outside 1 to 20 `limit is out of range`. Nothing is clamped.
- `latitude` and `longitude` are optional, both or neither, in WGS84 degrees; one without the other is a 400 naming the absent one `<name> is required`, not a decimal `<name> is invalid`, and outside -90 to 90 or -180 to 180 `<name> is out of range`.
- At most `limit` hits, best first: stops, then municipalities, districts and landmarks, then streets, then other points of interest and addresses. With `latitude` and `longitude` the nearest of equally good matches comes first and each hit carries `distance` in metres; without them distance plays no part.
- Hits come only from the environment's service area.
- A `q` with a digit lists individual addresses; without one, a street stands for its addresses.
- Abbreviated and spelled-out forms find each other (`žel. st.` and `železniční stanice`), and text without diacritics matches text with them.
- A stop's `id` is its feed-prefixed id, the value routing's `stopLocation.stopLocationId` takes; any other `id` is opaque.
- Addresses, streets and municipalities are from RÚIAN, the Czech register of addresses and territorial units (© ČÚZK, CC BY 4.0); points of interest are from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). Results carry those attribution obligations.
- A member that has no value is absent from a hit, never null.
- A query parameter not listed is a 400 `<name> is not allowed`, and a repeated one a 400 `<name> is invalid`. Another method is a 405 `method_not_allowed`.
- The response carries `ETag`, `Cache-Control: private, max-age=300` and `Vary: apikey`; a request whose `If-None-Match` matches the `ETag` (RFC 9110 weak comparison) is a 304 without a body.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text, 2 to 100 characters after trimming whitespace. Abbreviated and spelled-out forms find each other, and text without diacritics matches. With a digit, individual addresses are listed; without one, a street stands for its addresses. Absent or empty after trimming is a 400 `q is required`, and shorter or longer `q is out of range`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max hits to return, an integer from 1 to 20. Absent is a 400 `limit is required`, not an integer `limit is invalid`, and outside 1 to 20 `limit is out of range`; rejected, never clamped.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: WGS84 latitude in degrees, -90 to 90, with `longitude` or not at all; with both, a nearer hit ranks above an equally good farther one of the same kind and each hit carries `distance`. Present without `longitude` is a 400 `longitude is required`; not a decimal is `latitude is invalid`, and outside -90 to 90 `latitude is out of range`.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: WGS84 longitude in degrees, -180 to 180, with `latitude` or not at all. Present without `latitude` is a 400 `latitude is required`; not a decimal is `longitude is invalid`, and outside -180 to 180 `longitude is out of range`.

200.description: At most `limit` hits, best first. A better text match ranks higher; among equally good matches, stops come before other places. With `latitude` and `longitude`, the nearer of two equally good matches of the same kind comes first (distance is not compared between a stop and another place); without them, municipalities and landmarks come before streets, then other points of interest and addresses; addresses only when `q` holds a house number. Hits come only from the environment's service area.

Vary.description: `apikey`: a private cache keys the response by host, URL and `apikey`.

304.description: The result is unchanged: `If-None-Match` matches the current `ETag` under RFC 9110 weak comparison (`W/` tags, lists and `*` included). No body; `ETag`, `Cache-Control` and `Vary` as on a 200.

Vary.description: `apikey`: a private cache keys the response by host, URL and `apikey`.

400.description: `q` or `limit` absent is `<name> is required`, and so is `q` empty after trimming; `q` shorter than 2 or longer than 100 characters is `q is out of range`; `limit` not an integer is `limit is invalid`, and outside 1 to 20 `limit is out of range`. `latitude` or `longitude` without the other is `<name> is required`, naming the absent one; not a decimal is `<name> is invalid`, and outside its range `<name> is out of range`. A query parameter not listed is `<name> is not allowed`, and a repeated one `<name> is invalid`; `field` names it.

401.description: The `apikey` header is missing (`key_missing`) or holds no valid key (`key_invalid`).

403.description: The key is not allowed on this operation (`key_not_allowed`), or the agreement it belongs to is inactive (`agreement_inactive`).

429.description: The key's rate limit is reached (`rate_limited`).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a request is admitted again.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the key may make per rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix seconds at which the rate-limit window resets.

4XX.description: Another client error: 404 `not_found`, 405 `method_not_allowed`, 411 `length_required` (a body without a length) or 413 `payload_too_large`.

5XX.description: From Spider, an ErrorResponse: `internal_error`, `upstream_unavailable` or `upstream_timeout`. A network intermediary in front of Spider may answer a 5XX with a body that is not JSON.

apikey.name: apikey
apikey.description: The raw key in an `apikey` header (not Authorization: Bearer).

PlaceSearchResponse.description: Search hits, at most `limit`, best first.

PlaceHit.description: One place. A member that has no value is absent, never null. `country`, `region`, `district`, `city` and `suburb` are the admin areas the place lies in, derived the same way as a `StopHit`'s, so every hit is labelled alike.

id.description: For a `stop`, the stop's feed-prefixed id (`<feedId>:<id>`), the value routing's `stopLocation.stopLocationId` takes. For any other type, an opaque id, stable across searches.

type.description: What the place is: `stop`, `address`, `street`, `place` (a municipality) or `poi` (a point of interest). New values may be added; a client ignores a type it does not know.

name.description: Display name; a stop's is the operator's own.

category.description: What kind of place it is: for a `poi` e.g. `university`, `hospital`, `mall`, `cemetery`; for a `place` `municipality`; for an `address` `building`, or `recreational` for a recreational building; for a `street` `street`. Absent for a stop. New values may be added.

distance.description: Metres from `latitude`/`longitude`; present only when they were sent.

ErrorResponse.description: Error body: a stable machine-readable `code`, which names a state, and a human-readable `message`.

code.description: One of `bad_request`, `key_missing`, `key_invalid`, `key_not_allowed`, `agreement_inactive`, `planning_limit_reached`, `not_found`, `method_not_allowed`, `length_required`, `payload_too_large`, `rate_limited`, `internal_error`, `upstream_unavailable`, `upstream_timeout`. New codes may be added.

message.description: For `bad_request`: `<field> is required|invalid|out of range|not allowed`, or `body is invalid` when the body is empty, not JSON or not an object.

field.description: Present only on a 400 that names one member: its dot path from the body root, array positions omitted, or the query parameter's name.
